name: Sales Forecast Price Market Model
info: Linear regression model for predicting market prices based on sales forecast data. Supports multiple features for comprehensive price prediction analysis.

feature1.name: Market Volume
feature1.tooltip: The market volume or quantity sold in the forecast period

feature2.name: Seasonal Factor
feature2.tooltip: Seasonal adjustment factor (0.5-2.0) where 1.0 is baseline, >1.0 indicates higher demand seasons

feature3.name: Economic Index
feature3.tooltip: Economic health indicator (0-100) where higher values indicate stronger economic conditions

feature4.name: Competition Level
feature4.tooltip: Market competition intensity level from low to high competition
